verify_sound.detail: Nonempty Alice-to-Bob attachment, single chunk; output-size and universal second-preimage premises proved for an explicit three-output hash model, not SHA-256. Modified content/index rejected.

complete_assembles.detail: Nonempty one-chunk file with every verification premise proved; reconstructed bytes equal the original. Explicit hash model, not SHA-256.

no_injective_hash.detail: Concrete 32-byte-output hash proves size premise; global injectivity is impossible even though this file has no second preimage.

assumptions_hold.detail: Applies existing empty-file satisfiability theorem and proves a nonempty-file extension. Explicit model hash; no production SHA guarantee.
